headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: BOR (3)

summary: Max Verstappen won the Qatar Grand Prix from P3 on the grid, 8.0s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Carlos Sainz completing the podium.
Gabriel Bortoleto made the biggest climb, from P19 to P13.
Isack Hadjar had a day to forget, dropping from P6 to P18.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised OCO (5 second time penalty) and STR (5 second time penalty).
There were 41 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Lando Norris leads the championship by 12 points over Max Verstappen.
